questions.q: What is the practical difference between a primary ledger and a secondary ledger?
options: A secondary ledger replaces the primary ledger once a company grows large enough
A secondary ledger is only used for payroll, never for Financials
The primary ledger is the official book of record; a secondary ledger restates the same activity under a different accounting method or currency without changing the primary
There is no real difference; the terms are interchangeable in Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: The primary ledger is the official book of record. A secondary ledger provides a parallel, restated view (different method or currency) without altering the primary.

questions.q: In this course's vocabulary, what does the abbreviation SLA refer to?
options: Subledger Accounting, the engine that turns subledger transactions into balanced GL journals
Service level agreement, a client contract term
Sales ledger adjustment, a Receivables report
A security role used to restrict journal entry
questions.explain: In Oracle Financials, SLA means Subledger Accounting - the engine between the subledgers and the General Ledger. It is easy to confuse with the everyday 'service level agreement.'

questions.q: What does an accounting status of "Incomplete" on a subledger transaction actually mean?
options: The transaction was deleted before it could post
The transaction posted successfully but to the wrong period
The transaction is waiting on a manager's approval workflow
Create Accounting could not generate a journal for it, often because of a missing account rule mapping
questions.explain: Incomplete means Create Accounting's account rules could not fully resolve the transaction into a journal - a missing mapping is a common cause, as it was in the capstone.

questions.q: What is the one practical difference between FBDI and ADFdi as Oracle bulk-load methods?
options: FBDI only works for Payables; ADFdi only works for Receivables
FBDI loads data through file-based interface tables; ADFdi is an Excel-integrated interface for entering and uploading data directly
They are the exact same tool under two different marketing names
ADFdi requires a developer; FBDI can never be used by a functional consultant
questions.explain: FBDI is the standard file-to-interface-table bulk load method. ADFdi lets a user work in a connected Excel sheet and upload directly into Oracle Fusion.

questions.q: Why does the balancing segment on the chart of accounts matter for intercompany activity?
options: It has no connection to intercompany activity at all
It is only used for tax reporting, not for consolidation
It must net to zero for each legal entity, which is what makes intercompany elimination in consolidation possible
It determines which users can see which journals
questions.explain: The balancing segment (Company, in the capstone's design) must net to zero per legal entity. Without that discipline, intercompany balances can't cleanly eliminate in consolidation.
